+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import BinaryIO, Optional, Union
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def save_audio(audio: bytes, target: Union[str, os.PathLike, BinaryIO]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if hasattr(target, "write"):
+        target.write(audio)
+        return None
+    path = Path(target)
+    path.write_bytes(audio)
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def synthesize_and_save(text: str, target: Union[str, os.PathLike, BinaryIO], voice: str = "alloy", model: str = "gpt-4o-mini-tts") -> Optional[str]:
+    client = OpenAI()
+    response = client.audio.speech.create(model=model, voice=voice, input=text)
+    audio = response.read()
+    return save_audio(audio, target)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TTS_VOICES = ["alloy", "echo", "fable", "onyx", "nova", "shimmer"]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class VoiceOption:
+    name: str
+    locale: str
+
+
+def _normalize_locale(locale: str) -> str:
+    return locale.strip().lower().replace("_", "-")
+
+
+def _openai_tts_voices() -> List[VoiceOption]:
+    return [
+        VoiceOption("alloy", "en"),
+        VoiceOption("echo", "en"),
+        VoiceOption("fable", "en-gb"),
+        VoiceOption("onyx", "en"),
+        VoiceOption("nova", "en"),
+        VoiceOption("shimmer", "en"),
+    ]
+
+
+def list_voices(target_locale: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
+    voices = _openai_tts_voices()
+    if target_locale:
+        locale = _normalize_locale(target_locale)
+        filtered = [v for v in voices if v.locale == locale or v.locale.split("-")[0] == locale.split("-")[0]]
+    else:
+        filtered = voices
+    return [{"name": v.name, "locale": v.locale} for v in filtered]
+
+
+def select_voice(target_locale: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    locale = _normalize_locale(target_locale)
+    voices = _openai_tts_voices()
+    for voice in voices:
+        if voice.locale == locale or voice.locale.split("-")[0] == locale.split("-")[0]:
+            return {"name": voice.name, "locale": voice.locale, "provider": "openai"}
+    return {"name": voices[0].name, "locale": voices[0].locale, "provider": "openai"}
+
+
+def _openai_headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def fetch_openai_voice_selection(target_locale: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    headers = _openai_headers()
+    payload = {"target_locale": _normalize_locale(target_locale), "voices": OPENAI_TTS_VOICES}
+    response = requests.post("https://api.openai.com/v1/voices/select", headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, voice_name: str, speaking_rate: float = 1.0, pitch: str = "0st") -> bytes:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is required for Google Cloud Text-to-Speech")
+    endpoint = "https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize"
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "input": {"ssml": ssml},
+        "voice": {"languageCode": "en-US", "name": voice_name},
+        "audioConfig": {"audioEncoding": "MP3", "speakingRate": speaking_rate, "pitch": pitch},
+    }
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    audio_content = response.json()["audioContent"]
+    return base64.b64decode(audio_content)
+
*** End Patch
